newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China executes 68 drug traffickers - HK paper.
newsitem.headline: China executes 68 drug traffickers - HK paper.

text.p: China has executed 68 drug traffickers, a Hong Kong newspaper said on Friday.
The independent Ming Pao newspaper said authorities executed 14 in Beijing, 15 in the eastern province of Fujian, 24 in the western province of Sichuan and 15 in the southern city of Guangzhou.
The executions were carried out shortly after the announcement of the sentences, the newspaper said.
In Beijing and Guangzhou, the condemned were paraded in sports stadiums before being roped, handcuffed and loaded into trucks and taken to the execution ground outside the city.
Executions in China are usually carried out with a bullet to the back of the head.
